# Grand Tunis Traffic Drop

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** power_failure at `S-TUN-017`
- **Confidence:** low (No direct power alarm or transport failure alarm was recorded on the shared link or router.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-05 05:45 to 2026-09-05 09:03
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-05 05:56
- **Affected:** S-TUN-010, S-TUN-013, S-TUN-017

## Summary

Simultaneous site power or localized failures occurred across three sites sharing a common fiber link.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped to zero across three sites in Grand Tunis due to concurrent site outages.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-05 05:45: Anomaly ALR-0002 started for sites S-TUN-010, S-TUN-013, S-TUN-017. [ALR-0002]
- 2026-09-05 05:56: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-TUN-017. [ALM-000060]
- 2026-09-05 05:56: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-TUN-013. [ALM-000061]
- 2026-09-05 05:56: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-TUN-010. [ALM-000062]
- 2026-09-05 09:00: SITE_DOWN alarm on S-TUN-010 cleared. [ALM-000062]
- 2026-09-05 09:01: SITE_DOWN alarm on S-TUN-017 cleared. [ALM-000060]
- 2026-09-05 09:03: SITE_DOWN alarm on S-TUN-013 cleared. [ALM-000061]

## Evidence

- Sites S-TUN-010, S-TUN-013, and S-TUN-017 suffered concurrent SITE_DOWN critical alarms starting at 2026-09-05 05:56. [T3, ALM-000060, ALM-000061, ALM-000062]
- No changes were applied to S-TUN-010, S-TUN-013, S-TUN-017 and their parents between 2026-09-05 04:00 and 2026-09-05 09:05. [T4]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-010, S-TUN-013, S-TUN-017 and its parents between 2026-09-05 04:00 and 2026-09-05 09:05. [T6]
- Sites S-TUN-010, S-TUN-013, and S-TUN-017 share the same fiber link LNK-TUN-01-C and aggregation router AGG-TUN-01. [T5, T8, T9]
- The three site outages cleared automatically between 09:00 and 09:03 on 2026-09-05. [T10]

## Hypotheses

1. **power_failure** at S-TUN-017: unresolved. Simultaneous site failures point to power or site issues, but no direct power alarms were captured. [T3, T10]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-C: rejected. Alarms on the shared fiber link and aggregation router showed only the site down events without underlying link alarms. [T10, T11]
3. **bad_change** at AGG-TUN-01: rejected. No configuration changes were found on the affected sites or their parents during the incident window. [T4]

## Ruled out

- T4: Configuration changes were ruled out as get_changes reported no changes on the sites or their parents.
- T6: Maintenance was ruled out as get_maintenance reported no scheduled maintenance windows.
- T10: Shared transport link failure was ruled out because alarms on LNK-TUN-01-C and AGG-TUN-01 showed only SITE_DOWN for the specific sites without parent link failure alarms.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect site power logs for S-TUN-010, S-TUN-013, and S-TUN-017 around 2026-09-05 05:56.
- Verify equipment health on AGG-TUN-01 and LNK-TUN-01-C.

truth.notes: trap=missing_alarm; Fibre cut on LNK-TUN-01-C; all 3 downstream sites lost service until repair. The LINK_LOS alarm was never raised: only SITE_DOWN alarms on the sites exist. Trap: there is no alarm on LNK-TUN-01-C, only 3 SITE_DOWN alarms on sites, so a hasty investigator names a site or a set of independent site faults. Settled by: get_topology shows that the 3 sites share the parent LNK-TUN-01-C and that nothing else hangs under it; they went down in the same minute and sites on sibling links stayed up, so the shared link is the one cause.
